subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about pointing MAFO at the one event that pays your P&L: the funded account, the registered user who completes KYC and lands a first qualifying deposit in the wallet. The point worth repeating is that we read it back through a server-to-server postback before it counts, and every deposit clears four-layer fraud and bonus-abuse control first, so the volume you pay for at {Brand} is validated depositors, screened for multi-accounting and synthetic identity. Worth a short look at the funded-account read on Nigerian supply?
angle: warm bump, restate funded-account proof (S2S postback + four-layer fraud screen)
illustrative_flags: four-layer fraud and bonus-abuse control on the funded account (Tier-2 fraud-depth band for regulated funded-deposit verticals, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN fintech Nigeria: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof (funded account = KYC + first qualifying deposit, S2S postback before it counts + four-layer fraud/bonus-abuse screen); one illustrative MobUpps figure (four-layer fraud control); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English business register; no 'X, not Y'.
